script: The footprints astronauts left on the Moon could last a million years or more. The Moon has no wind or rain to wipe them away. The only thing slowly erasing them is a gentle rain of tiny meteorites. Twelve people walked on the Moon, all between 1969 and 1972. Their boot prints are still up there today, along with rovers, flags, and even golf balls. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
